cut_rhythm.pattern: 11 scenes, hard cuts only; each cut lands on a new caption phrase and/or a light/dark background flip; very short scenes 2-3 (0.434s, 0.666s) are caption-reflow micro-scenes inside one idea

shots.camera_angle: none: flat motion-graphics board, no camera footage
shots.composition: headline top-left (~y 8-20%), browser-window mockup in the middle (~y 35-70%), handle @heysansser small centered at ~y 83%, large empty bottom area

elements.easing: soft ease-out with slight overshoot on cards/badges (judged); words appear one by one with blur-to-sharp

text.role: kinetic captions as headline, word-by-word synced to voice; key words recoloured green (or purple for 'purple')
text.size_class: very large (cap height ~5% of frame height)
text.animation_in: word-by-word reveal with blur-to-sharp fade (frames show blurred 'for', 'whole page', 'and costs'); price words ($1, $20) larger and gradient green
text.animation_out: replaced at next cut/phrase; some phrases swap in place

grade.look: flat clean UI/brand look, no film grade; alternating white-mint and near-black-green backgrounds with emerald gradient accent

layout.safe_zones: headline sits inside top safe zone below hard 7.8% line; mockup centered; bottom ~35% mostly empty except small handle @heysansser
layout.framing_notes: mac-style browser window (red/yellow/green dots, url pill cloudbrew.top) is the main visual; floating rounded badges/app icons overlap its corner; green swoosh ribbon sweeps across lower third; concentric thin ring lines in background

recipe.notes: Alternate light/dark background per idea. Browser mockup component with url text. Floating badge component ($1/year, WIX $17.77/mo, Squarespace $19/mo, .com $11/yr struck vs .top $1). Overlays: red X over bad site, red box highlight, Claude Design UI mock with prompt typing, share-menu dropdown, Netlify 'live' toast, Kit subscriber toast, Clarity heatmap + 'recording a visit' pill. Spring values are estimated.
